arxiv-1806-00460.title: Assessing Perturbativity and Vacuum Stability in High-Scale Leptogenesis Preprint: IPPP/18/40 FERMILAB-PUB-18-222-T UCI-TR-2018-05
arxiv-1806-00460.creator: Seyda Ipek, Alexis D. Plascencia, and Jessica Turner
arxiv-1806-00460.description: Abstract We consider the requirements that all coupling constants remain perturbative and the electroweak vacuum metastable up to the Planck scale in high-scale thermal leptogenesis, in the context of a type-I seesaw mechanism. We find a large region of the model parameter space that satisfies these conditions in combination with producing the baryon asymmetry of the Universe.

arxiv-2205-05382.title: Generalizations of Bilinear Maps Technical Report
arxiv-2205-05382.creator: Tomáš Jakl, Dan Marsden, Nihil Shah
arxiv-2205-05382.description: Abstract Bilinear maps and their classifying tensor products are well-known in the theory of linear algebra, and their generalization to algebras of commutative monads is a classical result of monad theory. Motivated by constructions needed in categorical approaches to finite model theory, we generalize the notion of bimorphism much further.

arxiv-2210-08839.title: Using Mixed Precision in Low-Synchronization Reorthogonalized Block Classical Gram-Schmidt We acknowledge funding from the Charles University PRIMUS project No. PRIMUS/19/SCI/11, Charles University GA UK project No. 202722, Charles University Research Program No. UNCE/SCI/023, and the Exascale Compu
arxiv-2210-08839.creator: Eda Oktay, Erin Carson
arxiv-2210-08839.description: Abstract Abstract. Using lower precision in algorithms can be beneficial in terms of reducing both computation and communication costs. Motivated by this, we aim to further the state-of-the-art in developing and analyzing mixed precision variants of iterative methods. In this work, we focus on the block variant of low-synchronization classical Gram-Schmidt with reorthogonalization, which we call BCGSI+LS.

arxiv-2301-12853.title: Thermal bistability in laser-cooled trapped ions
arxiv-2301-12853.creator: A. Poindron, J. Pedregosa-Gutierrez, C. Champenois
arxiv-2301-12853.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Poindron, J. Pedregosa-Gutierrez, C. Champenois. The non-linear dynamics of large ion clouds ( N ≥ 256 N\geq 256 ions) trapped in radio-frequency traps and coupled to laser-cooling give rise to a bistable behaviour of the temperature. Numerical simulations of the free evolution of a large three-dimensional spherical cloud is used to characterise how the oscillating field amplitude and the ion number control the rf heating rate and the switching between the two stable states.

arxiv-2304-04437.title: Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation for Sports Broadcasts using Partial Sports Field Registration
arxiv-2304-04437.creator: Tobias Baumgartner, Stefanie Klatt
arxiv-2304-04437.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tobias Baumgartner, Stefanie Klatt. The filming of sporting events projects and flattens the movement of athletes in the world onto a 2D broadcast image. The pixel locations of joints in these images can be detected with high validity. Recovering the actual 3D movement of the limbs (kinematics) of the athletes requires lifting these 2D pixel locations back into a third dimension, implying a certain scene geometry.

arxiv-2307-14066.title: Pre-Training with Diffusion models for Dental Radiography segmentation
arxiv-2307-14066.creator: Jérémy Rousseau, Christian Alaka, Emma Covili, Hippolyte Mayard, Laura MisrachiWilly Au
arxiv-2307-14066.description: Abstract Medical radiography segmentation, and specifically dental radiography, is highly limited by the cost of labeling which requires specific expertise and labor-intensive annotations. In this work, we propose a straightforward pre-training method for semantic segmentation leveraging Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), which have shown impressive results for generative modeling.

arxiv-2310-10677.title: LLMs as Potential Brainstorming Partners for Math and Science Problems – Case Studies and Analysis
arxiv-2310-10677.creator: Sophia Gu
arxiv-2310-10677.description: Abstract With the recent rise of widely successful deep learning models, there is emerging interest among professionals in various math and science communities to see and evaluate the state-of-the-art models’ abilities to collaborate on finding or solving problems that often require creativity and thus brainstorming.

arxiv-2406-19005.title: Effective potential in leading logarithmic approximation in non-renormalisable S ​ O ​ ( N ) SO(N) scalar field theories
arxiv-2406-19005.description: Abstract The study of the effective potential for non-renormalisable scalar S ​ O ​ ( N ) SO(N) symmetric theories leads to recurrence relations for the coefficients of the leading logarithms. These relations can be transformed into generalised renormalization-group (RG) equation which can be analyzed in detail. In some special cases this equation can be solved exactly. R.M.

arxiv-2412-07698.title: Quantum vs. Classical Machine Learning Algorithms for Software Defect Prediction: Challenges and Opportunities
arxiv-2412-07698.creator: Md Nadim 1 , Mohammad Hassan 2 , Ashis Kumar Mandal 1 , Chanchal K. Roy 1
arxiv-2412-07698.description: Abstract Software defect prediction is a critical aspect of software quality assurance, as it enables early identification and mitigation of defects, thereby reducing the cost and impact of software failures. Over the past few years, quantum computing has risen as an exciting technology capable of transforming multiple domains; Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is one of them.

arxiv-2504-14580.title: Virtual Reality for Urban Walkability Assessment
arxiv-2504-14580.creator: Viet Hung Pham, Malte Wagenfeld, Regina Bernhaupt
arxiv-2504-14580.description: Abstract . Traditional urban planning methodologies often fail to capture the complexity of contemporary urbanization and environmental sustainability challenges. This study investigates the integration of Generative Design, Virtual Reality (VR), and Digital Twins (DT) to enhance walkability in urban planning.

pmc-10668030.title: Nuclear envelope assembly relies on CHMP-7 in the absence of BAF–LEM-mediated hole closure
pmc-10668030.creator: Sarah R Barger, Lauren Penfield, Shirin Bahmanyar
pmc-10668030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Barrier-to-autointegration factor (BAF) protein is a DNA-binding protein that crosslinks chromatin to allow mitotic nuclear envelope (NE) assembly. The LAP2-emerin-MAN1 (LEM)-domain protein LEMD2 and ESCRT-II/III hybrid protein CHMP7 close NE holes surrounding spindle microtubules (MTs). BAF binds LEM-domain family proteins to repair NE ruptures in interphase, but whether BAF–LEM binding participates in NE hole closure around spindle MTs is not known.

pmc-11490751.title: Neuropsychiatric and Cardiac Complications in Post-operative Antibiotic Therapy in Elderly Patients Undergoing Otorhinolaryngological Surgeries: A Review of Frailty Risk Indices
pmc-11490751.creator: Shraddha Jain, Ayushi Ghosh Moulic
pmc-11490751.description: With the increase in life expectancy and awareness, more otorhinolaryngologic surgeries are being performed in the elderly population. Otorhinolaryngologic surgeries like septoplasty, tympanoplasty, and dacryocystorhinostomy (DCR) surgeries are elective surgeries for improving the quality of life. However, post-operative medication can entail a risk to life or serious side effects in elderly patients.

pmc-11608824.title: On detecting and characterizing planetary oceans in the solar system using a distance-based ensemble modelling approach: application to the Uranus system
pmc-11608824.creator: C. J. Cochrane, S. D. Vance, J. B. Biersteker, M. J. Styczinski, B. Weiss
pmc-11608824.description: The discovery of Europa’s subsurface ocean has spawned a strong desire by the planetary community to return and assess the ocean’s habitability using the magnetic induction signal that Europa generates. NASA has since formulated and developed the Europa Clipper mission with that same goal, anticipating its arrival in the Jovian system in the early 2030s.

pmc-11611761.title: BBOX1‐AS1 promotes gastric cardia adenocarcinoma progression via interaction with CtBP2 to facilitate the epithelial–mesenchymal transition process
pmc-11611761.creator: Wenxu Zou, Qing Yin, Wei Guo, Zhiming Dong, Yanli Guo
pmc-11611761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). It is recognized that lncRNA BBOX1‐AS1 exerts a crucial oncogenic property in several cancer types. However, the functions and underlying mechanisms of BBOX1‐AS1 in the epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT) process of gastric cardia adenocarcinoma (GCA) have remained unclarified. The findings of this study demonstrated that GCA tissues had elevated BBOX1‐AS1 expression levels, which was associated with a worse prognosis in GCA patients. BBOX1‐AS1 dramatically enhanced cell proliferation, invasion, and TGF‐β1‐induced the EMT process in vitro.

pmc-11625340.title: Geometrical and dosimetrical evaluation of different interpretations of a european consensus delineation guideline for the internal mammary lymph node chain in breast cancer patients
pmc-11625340.creator: Emma Skarsø Buhl, Geert Wortel, Rita Simões, Astrid Scholten, Birgitte Vrou Offersen, Stine Korreman, Tomas Janssen
pmc-11625340.description: Highlights•Evaluation of the interpretation span in ESTRO delineation guideline for CTVn_IMN.•The interpretation span in delineation guidelines across borders were investigated.•Significant different width and distance to the sternal bone was found.•Different interpretations led to a significantly different dose to heart and lungs.•For individual patients, the dosimetric differences may impact treatment decisions.

pmc-12566606.title: Divergent Hepatic Outcomes of Chronic Ketone Supplementation: Ketone Salts Preserve Liver Health While Ketone Esters and Precursors Drive Inflammation and Steatosis
pmc-12566606.creator: Csilla Ari, Dominic P. D’Agostino
pmc-12566606.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Exogenous ketone supplements elevate circulating ketones without carbohydrate restriction, but their long-term hepatic safety remains unclear. This study evaluated the formulation-dependent impact of chronic ketone supplementation on liver histopathology, inflammatory signaling, and systemic biomarkers in rats. Methods: Male Sprague-Dawley rats were orally administered 1,3-butanediol (BD), medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), ketone ester (KE), ketone electrolytes/salts (KSs), or a ketone salt–MCT combination (KSMCT) for 4 weeks.

pmc-12574403.title: Cadonilimab combined with taxane and cisplatin as the first-line treatment of advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: an open-label, multicenter phase II trial
pmc-12574403.creator: Wang Qu, Jing Gao, Bo Zhang, Mudan Yang, Ying Wang, Yun Liu, Yijia Guo, Siying Guo, Jing Huang
pmc-12574403.description: BackgroundCadonilimab, a bispecific antibody simultaneously targeting programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) and cytotoxic T lymphocyte antigen 4, may further boost antitumor activity compared with PD-1 or programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) inhibitors. Here, we evaluated the safety and efficacy of cadonilimab combined with chemotherapy as the first-line treatment in advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC).

pmc-13159267.title: “I just feel alone and by myself”: how adolescents experience loneliness when their parent has cancer
pmc-13159267.creator: Lydia Mckeown, Martin Dempster, Jenny Groarke, Lisa Graham-Wisener
pmc-13159267.description: BackgroundParental cancer is a distressing experience for young people which is associated with an increased risk of behavioural and emotional issues as well as depression and anxiety. Systematic review evidence indicates that young people experiencing parental cancer report profound feelings of loneliness.

pmc-13358046.title: Quantum-inspired super-resolution of fluorescent point-like sources
pmc-13358046.creator: Cheyenne S. Mitchell, Dhananjay Dhruva, Zachary P. Burke, David J. Durden, Armine I. Dingilian, Mikael P. Backlund
pmc-13358046.description: We report the experimental super-resolution of pairs of point-like fluorescent sources using a modified image inversion interferometer microscope. The technique is inspired by recent developments in the application of quantum parameter estimation theory to semiclassical imaging problems. We find that the image inversion technique requires special polarization filtering to account for the dipolar nature of the emission.

uslaw-usc-t16-s430bb.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s430bb.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LX (National Military Parks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized and directed to make an examination of the Pea Ridge Battlefield with a view to determining the area or areas thereof deemed desirable for inclusion in the Pea Ridge National.
